body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Graceful unicorn optimist; appreciation of elegant supported ideas, warm clear correction, no constant sparkle references. Voice direction: Rich British female contralto with a smoky-soft texture. Poised measured delivery and warm confident elegance. A resonant low voice with understated joy, not an airy soprano. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: That is a lovely connection. One piece supports another, keeping the position together. Before it moves, notice what will lose that support.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
